result.summary: Fixes the default value of the codeseparator_pos parameter in TaprootSignatureMsg in the functional test framework, changing it from -1 to 0xFFFFFFFF so it matches the unsigned serialization used by to_bytes and doesn't raise OverflowError when a scriptpath=True call relies on the default.
result.problem: Any test writer who calls TaprootSignatureMsg with scriptpath=True and omits codeseparator_pos would hit an OverflowError because the default -1 cannot be encoded with the unsigned to_bytes call added elsewhere; currently no in-tree caller does this so CI does not catch it, but it is a trap for future test authors.

resolved_concerns: maflcko suggested using None like leaf_script; author explained 0xFFFFFFFF is the correct semantic value (BIP342 'no codeseparator executed'), not a sentinel, and None would require an extra branch with no benefit. No further pushback.

result.card: This is a one-line fix in the functional test framework's TaprootSignatureMsg helper, changing the default codeseparator_pos from -1 to 0xFFFFFFFF so it matches the unsigned to_bytes serialization and avoids an OverflowError. The bug is latent: no current in-tree caller exercises scriptpath=True while relying on the default, so CI does not currently fail, but any future test author who does would hit a crash. Review is trivial and complete: a reviewer (maflcko) asked about using None instead, and the author gave a clear rationale (0xFFFFFFFF is the correct BIP342 semantic value, not a sentinel) that went unchallenged. No dependencies, no open concerns, ready to merge.
